rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip to a unique account. It reviewed the user’s orders and item details using read-only tools, identified the correct items, and proposed suitable exchange options. Before making any changes, it clearly summarized the intended exchanges and requested explicit confirmation. When the user clarified to exchange only the desk lamp, the agent restated the exact change and asked for final confirmation. Only after receiving an explicit “yes” did it perform the exchange via the appropriate tool, using the correct item IDs and the user’s payment method on file. The agent calculated and communicated the price difference correctly. There is no evidence of acting on another account, making unsupported changes, or fabricating critical details. Minor potential concerns (stating the order was delivered and that an email would follow) are consistent with the tool used and standard process, and do not contradict tool data. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
